CVE-2010-0424.title: The edit_cmd function in crontab.c in (1) cronie before 1.4.4 and ...
CVE-2010-0424.description: The edit_cmd function in crontab.c in (1) cronie before 1.4.4 and (2) Vixie cron (vixie-cron) allows local users to change the modification times of arbitrary files, and consequently cause a denial of service, via a symlink attack on a temporary file in the /tmp directory.
